{{Quote|So that's it. The problem is simple&mdash;the ''solution'' isn't! Since the ''Tarkin'' was built without the single flaw that allowed us to stop the Death Star, a direct attack would be suicide! Our only chance for success is to get a small group of commandos ''inside'' the ''Tarkin''&mdash;and destroy it from within!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="SW51" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a crack team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] commandos '''infiltrated''' the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], in an attempt to destroy the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] from within before its construction could be completed. The Rebels succeeded in sabotaging the station when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] rewired the ''Tarkin''{{'s}} [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] activating mechanism to fire on itself.
